project_name: Doconnect — Home Visit Doctor & Healthcare Mumbai

theme.description: Clean, modern, highly trustworthy white-dominant medical aesthetic with teal-emerald accents, warm slate typography, generous white space, and soft rounded borders.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.15]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.2]

labels_and_badges.style: uppercase text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider text-teal-700 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-teal-200/60 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5

motion_and_interactions.principles: Subtle, fast, mobile-optimized, performance-first. No distracting heavy 3D or layout-shifting animations.

key_components.name: Header & Nav
key_components.details: White-dominant backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-100. Typographic 'Doconnect' wordmark with teal stethoscope accent dot. Desktop nav links: Home, About, Services, Doctor Home Visit, Locations, Packages, Doctors, Blog, FAQ, Contact. Action CTAs: 'Call Now' & 'Book Home Visit'.

key_components.name: Hero Section
key_components.type: Split Grid Hero with Trust Badges
key_components.details: Left: Masked line-by-line reveal heading 'Doctor Home Visits in Mumbai, When You Need Care at Home'. Subheading, 24/7 badge, 5.0 Google Rating pill, Quick Booking pill & Call CTAs. Right: High quality warm doctor home visit photography card with live doctor availability badge.

key_components.name: Why Choose Doconnect & Trust Strip
key_components.details: Verified Google Rating 5.0 badge (1 authentic review link), 24/7 Availability, Verified MBBD/MD Doctors, Rapid 60-Min Home Arrival, Sterilized Kits. Google Maps Directions integration block.

key_components.name: 11 Core Services Grid
key_components.details: Doctor for Home Visit, Sugar Check, Dressing & Wound Care, Urgent Care at Home, IV Fluid Therapy, Nursing Care, Physiotherapy at Home, Home Lab Testing, Mental Health Support, Nebulisation, Injection Administration, Urethral Catheterisation.

key_components.name: Appointment Booking Form (Docville-inspired + Enhanced)
key_components.details: Fields: Patient Full Name, Mobile Number, Email, Delivery Area (Mumbai Location), Preferred Date & Time Slots, Service Required. Action buttons: 'Confirm Home Visit' & 'Request Callback via WhatsApp'.

key_components.name: Mobile Sticky Bottom CTA Bar
key_components.details: Visible only on mobile (< 768px). Fixed bottom bar with 3 actions: Call Now (Phone icon), WhatsApp Us (WhatsApp green icon), Book Visit (Teal primary button).

key_components.name: Google Maps & Local SEO Section
key_components.details: Address: S-II C-1, BMC Colony, Anand Nagar, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053. Phone: 084248 45423. Google rating 5.0 badge with direct link to Google reviews and 'Get Directions' button.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly follow light, white-dominant, high-contrast healthcare design aesthetics.
Do NOT use pure black background or heavy dark gradients.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
Do NOT copy Docville directly, but ensure booking experience matches high usability standards.
Never imply more than 1 Google review for the 5.0 rating.
Ensure responsive mobile bottom sticky bar (Call | WhatsApp | Book) is present.
Never use generic AI emojis like 🤖 or 🧠 for UI icons; use Lucide or Phosphor icons.
